event.name: DOGFOOD 2026 Hackathon
event.tagline: Engineering the next generation of developer infrastructure

rubric.name: Technical Execution & Architecture
rubric.description: Depth of engineering complexity, code quality, robustness, and architectural soundness.

rubric.name: Originality & Technical Innovation
rubric.description: Novelty of approach, uniqueness of the problem solved, and creative problem solving.

rubric.name: Completeness & Functionality
rubric.description: Degree to which the core technical prototype works, edge cases handled, and demo reliability.

rubric.name: Clarity & Engineering Presentation
rubric.description: Quality of technical documentation, architectural diagrams, and clarity of the demo.

projects.title: Prometheus: Cloud-Native Systems Monitoring & Time Series Database
projects.summary: Graduated CNCF monitoring system and time series database powering observability across Kubernetes and distributed architectures.
projects.description: Prometheus collects and stores metrics as time series data, providing high-dimensional data model queries via PromQL, autonomous single-node server reliability, and real-time alerting.

projects.title: Excalidraw: Collaborative Virtual Hand-Drawn Whiteboard
projects.summary: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams with end-to-end encryption and real-time multiplayer collaboration.
projects.description: Excalidraw is a versatile web-based drawing tool built in React and TypeScript. Features infinite canvas rendering, SVG/PNG export, local storage persistence, and shareable collaboration links.

projects.title: Trivy: Comprehensive Container & Cloud Security Vulnerability Scanner
projects.summary: Fast and versatile security scanner detecting CVE vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, and SBOM licenses in container images and code repositories.
projects.description: Trivy by Aqua Security scans container registries, virtual machine filesystems, and Kubernetes clusters. Evaluates package dependencies against authoritative vulnerability databases with instant CLI reporting.

projects.title: Ollama: Local Large Language Model Execution & Serving Engine
projects.summary: Get up and running with open-weights LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma) locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows with hardware acceleration.
projects.description: Ollama bundles model weights, configurations, and datasets into a unified Modelfile. Features a high-performance REST API, OpenAI-compatible completion endpoints, and optimized GPU inference routines.

projects.title: Caddy Server: Enterprise-Grade Web Server with Automatic HTTPS
projects.summary: Lightweight, memory-safe, modular web server written in Go with built-in automatic TLS certificate generation and renewal via Let's Encrypt.
projects.description: Caddy simplifies production web serving and reverse proxying with concise Caddyfiles, dynamic JSON configuration APIs, zero-downtime reloads, and HTTP/3 support out of the box.

projects.title: HTTPie: Modern Human-Friendly Command-Line & Web HTTP Client
projects.summary: User-friendly CLI and API testing tool with JSON syntax highlighting, persistent sessions, formatted terminal output, and intuitive syntax.
projects.description: HTTPie is designed for seamless debugging and interaction with HTTP services. Features simple headers, effortless file uploads, SSL support, and an interactive web playground for modern API workflows.
